findings.detail: The instruction at 0x42AC86 loads R1 using an LDR literal whose aligned PC-relative pool address is 0x42AD3C. The word there is 0x400083E0. The prose says 'literal42AD40'; the word at 0x42AD40 is 0x0A04EEFB and is not the poll pointer. Identify 0x42AD3C as the literal location and 0x400083E0 as the argument value.
